C0821.title: IC3 Alert: Cybercriminals Exploit Credential Stuffing and Phishing to Steal Business Accounts
C0821.summary: The U.S. Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3) issued a warning detailing how cybercriminals use brute force, phishing emails, and social engineering to obtain employee login credentials, then take over corporate bank, payroll, or health savings accounts. By altering direct deposit information, they redirect employee wages or company funds to accounts they control, causing direct financial loss.
